title: The CM-03 population does not reconcile: 38 vs 421
area: Audit domain: ITGCs, populations, sampling, evidence
scenario: The external auditor rejects MFH's H1 CM-03 population: 38 changes extracted from the source-control API against 421 in DeployHub's production deploy log. The export exits 0 with no errors; the team blames time zones, token scope and a GHE upgrade.
task: Reproduce the extraction and read the request-level export log
Prove the root cause and rule each theory in or out with evidence
Fix the client so extraction is complete for any server page cap and cannot loop
Write the auditor note in IPE terms and the control that stops a silent short extraction
acceptance: Population reconciles to the deploy log
All PRs fetched for several caps and page sizes with the right number of requests
Pagination loops are bounded; the time-zone filter is untouched
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md match the injected fault
